components.name: SlideGame
components.doc: A slide game with fake money: a strip of multiplier tiles shoots past a center marker, slows down and stops on the multiplier that pays the bet.

components.name: GameFrame
components.doc: The card around a game: title, a "Play money" tag, the balance and its reset.

components.name: BetField
components.doc: Bet amount with half, double and max shortcuts. Typing is free; the amount is clamped when the field loses focus.

components.name: AmountField
components.doc: A small optional number, such as a target multiplier.

components.name: FieldGroup
components.doc: A labelled slot for a custom control, aligned with the bet field.

components.name: PlayButton
components.doc: The main action of a game. One button keeps focus while its label changes (Bet, Cash out, …).

components.name: HistoryChips
components.doc: A row of past results. A new chip springs in at the start and pushes the others along.

members.name: multiplier
members.doc: Multiplier paid when the strip stops on this tile.

members.name: weight
members.doc: Relative chance of this tile: a weight of 2 comes up twice as often as a weight of 1.

members.name: id
members.doc: Round number, starting at 1.

members.name: multiplier
members.doc: Multiplier the strip stopped on.

members.name: bet
members.doc: Amount bet.

members.name: payout
members.doc: Amount paid back.

members.name: balance
members.doc: Controlled play-money balance.

members.name: defaultBalance
members.doc: Starting balance when uncontrolled; the reset button returns to it.

members.name: onBalanceChange
members.doc: Called with the new balance after a bet, a payout or a reset.

members.name: defaultBet
members.doc: Bet amount shown at first.

members.name: minBet
members.doc: Smallest bet.

members.name: tiles
members.doc: The kinds of tile on the strip and how often each comes up.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Seconds the strip takes to slide and slow down to its result.

members.name: onRoundEnd
members.doc: Called when the strip has stopped, with the result.

members.name: random
members.doc: Random source returning a number in [0, 1). Called only after a bet, to pick the result and fill the strip.

members.name: title
members.doc: Name shown in the header.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the card.

members.name: balance
members.doc: Controlled balance.

members.name: defaultBalance
members.doc: Starting balance when uncontrolled; a reset returns to it.

members.name: onBalanceChange
members.doc: Called with the new balance after a bet, a payout or a reset.

members.name: id
members.doc: Changes on every payout, so the same amount twice still animates.

members.name: amount
members.doc: Amount paid.

members.name: balance
members.doc: Current fake balance.

members.name: gain
members.doc: The latest payout, for the "+12.40" flyer next to the balance.

members.name: spend
members.doc: Takes a bet out of the balance. Returns false (and takes nothing) when the balance is too low.

members.name: pay
members.doc: Adds a payout to the balance.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Returns the balance to its starting amount.

members.name: title
members.doc: Name of the game, shown in the header and used as the region label.

members.name: money
members.doc: The balance from `usePlayMoney`.

members.name: busy
members.doc: True while a round is running: the reset button waits for it to end.

members.name: announcement
members.doc: Result text for screen readers, announced politely.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the card.

members.name: children
members.doc: The stage and controls of the game.

members.name: value
members.doc: Bet amount.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the new amount, already clamped between `min` and `max`.

members.name: min
members.doc: Smallest bet.

members.name: max
members.doc: Largest bet, usually the balance.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Locks the field, for example while a round runs.

members.name: label
members.doc: Field label.

members.name: label
members.doc: Field label.

members.name: value
members.doc: Text in the field (digits and one dot). Empty means "not set".

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the cleaned text on every edit.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Shown while the field is empty.

members.name: suffix
members.doc: Short unit after the number, for example "×".

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Locks the field.

members.name: label
members.doc: Label above the control.

members.name: children
members.doc: The control: a stepper, a segmented choice…

members.name: labelKey
members.doc: Identifies the label: when it changes, the old label slides out and the new one slides in.

members.name: tone
members.doc: "accent" for the main action, "neutral" for a waiting state.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Turns the action off. The button stays focusable (aria-disabled), so keyboard focus is never lost while a round runs.

members.name: onClick
members.doc: Runs the action.

members.name: children
members.doc: Label content.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable key of the round.

members.name: label
members.doc: Text of the chip, for example "2.31×".

members.name: tone
members.doc: "low" is muted, "mid" is tinted, "high" takes the accent fill.

members.name: entries
members.doc: Past results, newest first.

members.name: label
members.doc: Label of the list for screen readers.
